changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate task entries, corrected model name from 'OLMö 2' to 'OLMo 2', normalized dataset names, and added missing relevant task (General Reasoning) and dataset (ARC-C)
Removed 'exact_match' metric as it is not explicitly mentioned in the paper; only 'accuracy' is consistently used throughout the evaluation sections
No LLM-as-judge evaluation methods are used in the paper; only automated metrics and comparisons are employed
The paper does not conduct any human evaluations; all assessments are based on automated metrics

overall_notes: The paper focuses on fine-tuning transfer methods rather than traditional NLG evaluation. While it evaluates NLG tasks (code generation, instruction following, reasoning), the primary contribution is methodological. Extracted metadata was mostly accurate but contained some duplicates and minor inconsistencies that were normalized.
